Checks local risk rules and intent patterns; spending history and current sanctions status remain unverified. Non-rejected requests require human review; this tool does not authorize transactions. Required tool arguments: request. Grades supplied evidence; it does not independently verify source truth. HTTP, MCP and native A2A share the allowance and daily capacity is limited. Other tools are not included in this trial. Evaluation on paid endpoints requires Base USDC payment or Pro access. Standard x402 v2, when enabled, signs a one-transfer authorization and durably binds its first admitted request. Legacy payment uses a funding-wallet signature over the exact request. Discovery is free. Keep the original request and X-Payment-Signature for result recovery within 24 hours. Current prices: https://agent-financial-guard.agendamcp.dpdns.org/.well-known/x402. Do not pay automatically. Evidence triage only: no factual-truth verification, no legal, compliance, sanctions, or financial advice. Human review is required before any commercial action.
